name: Axis 360 Apartments
about: Axis 360 is more than just a place to stay. Our fun and vibrant community is conveniently located near the University of Buffalo and Buffalo State, making it the perfect place to stay while you attend college! Living here, you’ll have space and privacy to study or the opportunity to let your hair down and enjoy the various resident events available. Come join us and make your college experience an unforgettable one.

name: The Station at Buffalo
address: 1185 Sweet Home Road, Buffalo, New York 14226
about:
The Station at Buffalo offers popular student apartments in Buffalo NY, featuring single rooms designed for students to live in a big flat with their roommates. The Station Buffalo is thoughtfully equipped with essential amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi, an in-unit washer/dryer, and stainless steel appliances complemented by elegant quartz countertops. Students at The Station at Buffalo enjoy a private living space complete with a bed, TV, desk and chair, mattress, dresser, and closet, as well as a fully equipped bathroom that includes a bathtub, toilet, wash basin, mirror, and towel rack. The Station at Buffalo promotes a strong sense of community through shared spaces such as a lounge, business center, and study room, fostering collaboration and social interaction among residents. Students also benefit from a range of property services, including reliable Wi-Fi throughout the premises. For fitness enthusiasts, The Station at Buffalo Apartments features an impressive array of recreational facilities, including a heated lap pool, gym, and clubhouse, perfect for unwinding after a long day. Additionally, a pet park is available for furry companions, enhancing the community's welcoming atmosphere. Outdoor amenities include private balconies for enjoying fresh air and an outdoor grilling area for social gatherings.
 
With convenient access to public transportation, Buffalo State SUNY is just a 23-minute bus ride away, making commuting effortless for students. The nearest bus station, Sweet Home Rd & The Station Apartme, is conveniently located near The Station at Buffalo, providing easy transit options. The surrounding area in Amherst, with a variety of restaurants, bars, cafes, shopping centers, and supermarkets, ensures that students have everything they need within proximity.

name: Aspen Heights Buffalo
university: State University of New York at Buffalo State University
about:
Aspen Heights Buffalo offers cheap student housing in Buffalo NY. There are spacious single rooms within large flats designed specifically for student living. It is suitable for the students who want to live with their friends. The rooms at Aspen Heights Buffalo Apartments are well-appointed with a range of amenities such as comfortable chairs, ample storage in closets, and a TV for relaxation. The kitchen features modern stainless steel appliances including a microwave, oven, and dishwasher, alongside the convenience of an in-unit washer/dryer. Additional comforts include a nightstand and a double-size bed, ensuring a restful environment. Students who live in Aspen Heights Buffalo NY also benefit from a refrigerator with a freezer, essential for storing groceries, and heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort. High-speed internet access is available throughout, facilitating academic pursuits and staying connected with family and friends. Other thoughtful additions include an ice maker, disposal, floor lamp, and electric range, enhancing the functionality and convenience of the living space. Shared community amenities at Aspen Heights Buffalo include a surface parking lot for easy vehicle access, a lounge area for social gatherings, and a study room for focused academic sessions.
 
Aspen Heights Buffalo NY offers a variety of recreational and fitness facilities to cater to students' active lifestyles. These include a swimming pool for relaxation and exercise, a fully equipped gym for workouts, and a heated lap pool for year-round fitness activities. A tanning bed is available for those seeking a sun-kissed glow, while a coffee bar and pool table provide additional opportunities for relaxation and socialization. Outdoor features include an outdoor grilling area, perfect for enjoying meals and gatherings with friends in pleasant weather. Aspen Heights Buffalo Apartments also provides convenient services such as free printing, and supporting students' academic and administrative needs.
 
Located in the East Amherst/Williamsville neighbourhood, it provides convenient access to Buffalo State SUNY via a 45-minute bus ride, making it ideal for students seeking proximity to campus without sacrificing suburban comforts. You can find modern shopping centres near Aspen Heights Buffalo, expansive natural areas like Nature View Park, and a diverse selection of restaurants along Main Street, Aspen Heights Buffalo Apartments offers a well-rounded living experience that combines the tranquility of suburban life with the convenience of urban amenities.

name: Monarch 716
about: Monarch 716 is a student housing apartment complex just blocks away from Buffalo State, Buffalo, NY. Offering a relaxing home environment where students can unwind from the day to day college experience. Comprised of beautifully styled two- and four-bedroom homes.

name: Villas on Rensch
address: 100 Villas Drive East Amherst, Buffalo, New York 14228
about:
With huge townhome floor plans, huge bedrooms, and giant walk-in closets, Villas on Rensch isn't your normal student housing apartment - it's extra-large living for your extra-large college life at the University at Buffalo. Stay fit with our 24-hour, state-of-the-art fitness center. Unwind with friends in the fully-loaded recreation center, or cook up a gourmet meal in your modern kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances.
And when it comes to making the grades at UB, study right in our Academic Success Center with iMacs and free printing.

name: Auden Buffalo
address: 2915 North Forest Road, Buffalo, New York 14068
about:
Auden Buffalo offers modern student housing in Buffalo at 2915 North Forest Road, Buffalo, New York(NY) 14068. The students can choose from single rooms, studios, and 1-bedroom apartments, with a 10-minute ride to the Buffalo State SUNY. Auden Apartments provides furnished pet-friendly apartments with in-unit full-size washers and dryers, central AC, and high-speed internet access. 
 
The residents at Auden Buffalo can enjoy the convenience of move-in ready-furnished units with modern furniture. The spacious kitchen is equipped with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, giving you a functional space to prepare meals. Auden Apartments also provides central air-conditioning to ensure you stay in comfortable rooms, making you feel cool in the hot summer and warm environment in the chilly winter. You can also access the high-speed WiFi across the apartments to do your schoolwork and entertainment. The full-size washer and dryer in each unit at Auden Buffalo allows the residents to do the laundry more easily. 
 
Besides, the residents can take advantage of community amenities at Auden Buffalo. Grab some popcorn and watch a movie with your friends in the movie theater or unwind in Jacuzzis and Hot Tubs. Auden Apartments has a 2374-square-foot clubhouse for you to socialize with your neighbors, including foosball tables, pool tables, study pods, an electronics bar, and comfortable lounging couches. The study lounge provides a quiet environment to write your paper instead of a long distance from the campus library. The BBQ grills offer you large space to gather friends and have a great meal on a good weather day, and the fire pits are the warm place in the cold winter for you to stay with friends and socialize. Auden Buffalo also provides a resort-style swimming pool with lounge areas and a yoga studio where you can meditate and stretch after your workout. There is also an ample fitness center with top-of-the-line equipment to keep you active. The Amazon Hub at Auden Buffalo provides pick-up services that you can access 24/7. The indoor parking can ensure your vehicle is parked in a safe environment. The residents can also enjoy the convenience of valet trash service, and the staff will pick up the trash 5 days a week. Auden Buffalo offers shuttle bus services to take you to the campus and other popular spots like shopping centers and grocery stores. 
 
Around Auden Buffalo, you can find various dining options, bars, cafes, and other entertainment options in your leisure time, including Lebro's Restaurant, Elmo's RESTAURANT & BAR, Burrito Bay, and Taste of Lebanon. The closest bus station is at Weinberg Driveway North Forest Road.
